text: S471 found no reviewed free receiver that both works for Windows 11 and meets V03 inside the local/no-hosted scope. Seamly2D lacks DXF import; OpenMarker lacks export; garment.dev is hosted/invite-only. Richpeace V8 remains the strongest exchange lead but Windows 11 support is unlisted. See E-G04-S471-EXIT.
